prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A middle-aged male doctor with neatly styled brown hair and a trimmed beard stands in the foreground, wearing a crisp white lab coat over a shirt and dark tie. His expression is serious and contemplative as he gazes off to the side, suggesting deep thought or concern. The doctor’s name tag is visible on his coat, adding authenticity to his professional appearance. Behind him, a whiteboard on an easel displays handwritten medical notes, with the words “Symptoms: Buzz Deficiency” clearly legible, hinting at a clinical or educational setting. In the background, several other doctors in white coats are seated at a table, engaged in discussion or work, further emphasizing the collaborative, institutional atmosphere. The room features mint-green walls and fluorescent lighting, creating a clean, clinical ambiance. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, keeping the main subject sharply in focus while softly blurring the background, drawing attention to his presence and the whiteboard. The overall color palette is cool and muted, dominated by whites, greens, and subtle grays, enhancing the professional, medical tone of the scene. The camera angle is at eye level, lending a sense of realism and immediacy, as if the viewer is present in the room. The style is reminiscent of a high-quality medical drama, with cinematic lighting and careful attention to detail in costume and set design.
